The '''Aurora Medical Facility''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]], not far from the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. It had existed for at least sixty-two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], as early as [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and as late as [[43 ABY]].

It was capable of sustaining patients with severe injuries or medical conditions for long periods of [[Time/Legends|time]], such as in the case of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tobb Jadak]]. The facility was able to implant memories, install prostheses, and generally rejuvenate patients far beyond their normal lifespans, with [[Human/Legends|Humans]] treated there living as far as 150 years of age. The facility also used nerve splicing and deep [[Neuron/Legends|neuron]] stimulation, as well as muscle stimulation to prevent resorption and atrophy.

[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[psychotherapist]] [[Ril Bezant]] and [[Chief Neurologist]] [[Lial Sompa]] were staff at the facility. [[Nurse/Legends|Nurses]] and aides consisted of Humans and [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]]. The facility also made use of several [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] including [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]], [[FX-10 medical assistant droid]]s, [[GH-7 medical analysis unit]]s and [[MD-11 medical droid|MD series 11 medical specialists]].
